interface: I2C @ 0x62, 3.3 V; note ~175 mA emitter pulses on the supply rail

measurands.name: co2_ppm
measurands.accuracy: ±(40 ppm + 5% of reading) for 400-2000 ppm; wider above

failure_modes: flat ~400 ppm indoors with people present: inlet at a window/door, or ASC recalibrated against a non-ambient baseline
slow multi-week drift: automatic self-calibration history; needs a weekly fresh-air exposure
reading spikes with door events: inlet in an airflow path, remount
mounting: breathing-zone height 1.1-1.7 m, >50 cm from people, away from windows and doors
